svg.title: Insurance steps before a teen drives in Canada
svg.desc: Tell the insurer before the first drive, match the licence class and any training certificate, assign a vehicle honestly, allow only listed drivers, budget the premium, and re-quote when the licence class changes. Not a quote.
svg.text: Before the keys, then at each new class
Sequence only. Premium dollars come from a quote. 24 Sep 2026.
1. Notify the insurer before the teen drives
2. Licence class and training certificate, as printed
3. Assign the vehicle they will actually use
5. Put the premium in the month's plan
Re-quote at the next class: G2 or full G in Ontario, or the probationary step in your province.
A learner's licence is not permission to drive alone. Confirm conditions on the provincial ministry page.
The young-driver guide is the rating math. This chart is the order of the phone calls.
